issues.source_quote: Ещё не поздравил! - С чем? - Со стихийным бедствием!
issues.translation_quote: Haven't congratulated you yet! - On what? - On the natural disaster!
issues.justification: Acceptable literally, but fine. (Low-weight note.)

issues.source_quote: А и Б играли на трубе!
issues.translation_quote: A and B sat on a trumpet!
issues.justification: The reference is to the Russian riddle 'А и Б сидели на трубе' (sat on a pipe); the pun on 'труба' as pipe/trumpet and the idiom meaning 'it's nonsense' is lost and the rendering is baffling.

issues.source_quote: Зря картину не взяли по перечислению "Медведи на отдыхе".
issues.translation_quote: Pity we didn't buy that painting by bank transfer, "Bears at Rest".
issues.justification: The joke on the Shishkin painting 'Morning in a Pine Forest' (bears) and bureaucratic 'по перечислению' (from the list) is mistranslated; 'bank transfer' misreads it as an item on the list.

issues.translation_quote: Three cubic meters of planks for that.
issues.justification: Fine content, but the speaker is the accountant Fyodor Petrovich and the joke is that he is interested only in budget; acceptable. Minor loss of dry-humor.

issues.source_quote: Чё? - Котов. - Правильно, котов урезать до минимума.
issues.translation_quote: Wha? - The cats. - Correct, cut the cats to a minimum.
issues.justification: The humor of cutting 'cats' in budget while Puss in Boots was planned is garbled: 'Puss in Boots' becomes 'cats' without the joke that 'Коты в сапогах' loses boots; the budget gag is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Горько, горько! - Что? Горько товарищи, чувствовать, что мы стали на год старше
issues.translation_quote: Gorko, gorko! - What? It's bitter, comrades, to feel that we've grown a year older
issues.justification: Transliterated 'Gorko' (wedding cry 'Bitter! Kiss!') is unexplained for English audience, and Ogurtsov's misreading pun is lost.

issues.translation_quote: To Mr. Cucumber, thank you
issues.justification: The grandfather's slip (Огурец for Огурцов) is rendered inconsistently with 'Ogurtsov' elsewhere; 'Mr. Cucumber' introduces an unexplained shift and the sense of the joke is muddled.

issues.source_quote: Ансамбль пенсии и пляски! Виноват, простите, ансамль Песни и пляски!
issues.translation_quote: The Pension and Dance Ensemble! My mistake, sorry, the Song and Dance Ensemble!
issues.justification: The pun on 'песни' vs 'пенсии' is lost, since 'Pension' and 'Song' do not sound alike in English.

issues.translation_quote: But they also serve up great promise!
issues.justification: Acceptable pun-ish rendering; but 'serve up' keeps wordplay on 'подавать надежды' adequately. Minor concern only.

issues.translation_quote: Fanfan la Tulipe and Onegin
issues.justification: Acceptable; no major issue.

issues.translation_quote: sirrrious
issues.justification: Rendering Ogurtsov's mispronunciation 'сурьёзно' as 'sirrrious' is a reasonable device but it is applied inconsistently (some 'serious' are normal, e.g. 'serious' elsewhere) and the odd spelling reads as a rolled r, not the Russian soft-insertion substandard.

issues.source_quote: Три храбреца, три храбреца в одном тазу
issues.translation_quote: Three brave men, three brave men in one tub
issues.justification: The song is the Russian rendition of 'Three Wise Men of Gotham'; the 'tub/basin' is correct but the song's rhyme and metre are lost; verses are rendered as flat prose.

issues.source_quote: Вы, собственно, соображаете, что вы делате?!
issues.translation_quote: Do you actually realize what you're doing?!
issues.justification: Neutral; loses Ogurtsov's bureaucratic pompous tone.

issues.source_quote: Могу поздравить! - Ну зачем ты выключил?
issues.translation_quote: Well done, a funny idea! Congratulations!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Нужно, чтоб музыка тебя так сказать.. Брала! Нужно, как говориться, чтоб она тебя вела! Но в тоже время и не уводила..
issues.translation_quote: Grab you! It has to, as they say, lead you! But at the same time not lead you astray..
issues.justification: 'Брала' (grip/captivate) rendered as 'Grab you' is crude; the bureaucratic cliché register is weakened.

issues.source_quote: - Нет, вздохнул и ушёл. - Костя, можно у тебя прослушать эту пластинку?
issues.translation_quote: The known stranger said nothing else?
issues.justification: The pun 'известный-неизвестный' is rendered clumsily and does not land.

issues.translation_quote: They're making a clown out of the director, you understand?!
issues.justification: 'Петрушка' (a Russian puppet-show buffoon) becomes a generic 'clown', losing the specific cultural reference and the earlier 'какая-то петрушка' echo ('some kind of nonsense').

issues.translation_quote: A and B
issues.justification: Duplicate; ignore.

issues.translation_quote: Tosya Burykina ... Tosya Burakina
issues.justification: Source's deliberate name mix-up by the announcer is preserved, fine; no issue.

issues.source_quote: Вы за это ответите!Я буду жаловаться в ВЦСПС!
issues.translation_quote: I'll complain to the Central Trade Union Council!
issues.justification: Acceptable; minor only.

issues.translation_quote: Hello, Top? - Hello.
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: - Вся соль! - А при чём тут соль?
issues.translation_quote: - The salt of it! - What's salt got to do with it?
issues.justification: Salt/tears pun is preserved only vaguely; 'the salt of it' is not an English idiom for 'the point of the joke', so the connection to tears is weak.

issues.translation_quote: Modern technology.
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Что ж такое?... - Господи, ведь надо же, артист!
issues.translation_quote: What on earth?... - Lord, would you believe it, an artist!
issues.justification: Acceptable.

issues.translation_quote: Get your masks
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.translation_quote: It's not typical!
issues.justification: Ogurtsov's bureaucratic catchphrase 'нетипично/типично' is rendered literally and sounds odd in English; 'That's not how it's done' or similar would carry the officialese better.

issues.translation_quote: Sleight of hand, and no report!
issues.justification: Fine; no issue.

issues.translation_quote: composer Crucini
issues.justification: 'Кручина' means sorrow; the joke name is turned into an Italian-sounding name, losing the meaning that matches the mournful music.

issues.translation_quote: Svirestinsky-Shmygaev
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.source_quote: Зачем барсук присел на сук? Зачем хорёк пошёл в ларёк?
issues.translation_quote: Why did the badger sit on a bough? Why did the ferret go to the kiosk?
issues.justification: The rhyming nonsense couplets (барсук/сук, хорёк/ларёк) lose their rhymes; the fable's playful rhythm is flattened.

issues.translation_quote: This is turning into some kind of nonsense.
issues.justification: Acceptable.

issues.translation_quote: We need Gogols and Shchedrins!
issues.justification: Acceptable.

issues.translation_quote: House of Stage Veterans
issues.justification: Fine.

issues.translation_quote: Puss in Boots
issues.justification: Source plural ('Cats in Boots', several characters) rendered singular; later 'the cats' creates inconsistency.
